IOHN.|265 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>amen I say to you, that you shal vveepe, and lament, but the vvorld shal reioyce: and you shal be made sorovvful, but your sorovv shal be turned into ioy. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=21}}† A vvoman vvhen she trauaileth, hath sorovv, because her houre is come: but vvhen she hath brought forth the childe, novv she remembreth not the anguish for ioy, that a man is borne into the vvorld. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=22}}† And you therfore, novv in deede you haue sorow, but I vvil see you againe, and your hart shal reioyce: and your ioy no man shal take from you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=16|verse=23}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the 5 Sunday after Easter.}}And in that day me you shal not aske any thing. Amen, amen I say to you, if you aske the Father any thing {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Vpon this the Church concludeth al her praiers, ''Per Christum Dominum nostrū'', euen those also that be made to Saincts.}}∷ in my name, he vvil giue it you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=24}}† Vntil novv you haue not asked any thing in my name. Aske and you shal receiue: that your ioy may be ful. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=25}}† These things in prouerbes I haue spoken to you. The houre commeth vvhen in prouerbes I vvil no more speake to you, but plainely of the Father I vvil shew you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=26}}† In that day you shal aske in my name: and I say not to you, that I vvil aske the Father for you. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=27}}† For the Father him self loueth you, because you haue loued me, and haue beleeued that I came forth from God. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=28}}† I came forth from the Father, and came into the vvorld: againe I leaue the vvorld, and I goe to the Father.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=29}}† His disciples say to him, Behold novv thou speakest plainely, and saiest no prouerbe. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=30}}† novv vve knovv that thou knovvest al things, and thou needest not that any man aske thee. in this vve beleeue that thou camest forth from God.⊣ {{verse|chapter=16|verse=31}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered them, Novv do you beleeue? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=32}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 27, 31. Mr. 14, 27.''}}* Behold the houre commeth, and it is novv come, that you shal be scattered euery man into his ovvne, and me you shal leaue alone: and I am not alone, because the Father is vvith me. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=33}}† These things I haue spoken to you, that in me you may haue peace. In the vvorld you shal haue distresse: but haue confidence, I haue ouercome the vvorld.

''12. Yet many things.'') This place conuinceth that the Apostles and the faithful be taught many things, which Christ omitted to teach them for their weaknes: and that it was the prouidence of God that Christ in presence should not teach and order al things, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Christ left many things to be taught by the Church.}}that we might be no lesse assured of the things that the Church teacheth by the Holy Ghost, then of the things that him self deliuered.<noinclude>{{rh||Ll|''13.
